mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in CPIAUCSL exceeding 0.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL MoM change exceeds 0.5%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and strong payroll growth (PAYEMS MoM growth > 0.5%) indicate a tight labor market, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle economic expansion, low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals potential overheating and imminent Federal Reserve rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansions, or the Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Robust industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0) indicates strong manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1400.0) signals weakening residential demand, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls below 1400.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales growth (RSAFS MoM > 0.5%) combined with rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) signals a strong economy with tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During supply chain disruptions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) indicates severe manufacturing constraints, reducing corporate profitability and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100.0 during supply chain disruptions, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
